translationRepairs: Book of Sui, 43th year of Volume, eighth year of Biographies
卷四十三列傳第八 is Volume 43, Biographies 8; the idiomatic wrongly reads 卷/第 as 'year' and invents dating the Chinese does not support.
Hejian Wang Hong, styled Bie'e, was a younger male cousin of Emperor Gaozu's father.
Hejian Wang Hong, styled Bie'e, was a younger paternal-line cousin of Gaozu.
高祖從祖弟也 makes Hong Gaozu's junior paternal-line cousin (從祖弟), not a cousin of Gaozu's father; the proposed literal restores that kinship.
sixth year of In of Daye (610), he was posthumously created Prince of Xun.
In the sixth year of Daye (610), he was posthumously created Prince of Xun.
大業六年 is the sixth year of Daye; 'In of Daye' is a garbled reign title and the proposed fix matches the Chinese.
When the emperor visited the Yunyang Palace, Prince Zhi of Wei rebelled and led his followers in an assault on the Su Zang Gate; Xiong met the attack and routed them.
When the emperor visited the Yunyang Palace, Prince Zhi of Wei rebelled and led his followers in an assault on the Suzhang Gate; Xiong met the attack and routed them.
肅章門 is the Suzhang Gate; 'Su Zang' is a corrupted transcription, and the proposed idiomatic wording corrects the gate name without changing the rest of the sentence.
